name: Integrations for mautic
author: Indemdedia

sections.description:
Integrations for Mautic connects your WordPress with your Mautic instance in a simple way.
It automatically sends data from Elementor Pro forms or WooCommerce orders directly to Mautic.

Main features:
* Secure connection via OAuth2 with your Mautic.
* Automatic insertion of the Mautic tracking script on your site.
* Send leads from Elementor PRO Forms.
* Basic synchronization with WooCommerce (customers/orders).
* Simple settings panel from the WordPress admin.

⚡ For advanced features (mass synchronization, custom fields, premium support, UTM Tags, etc.), check out the PRO version at indedmedia.com.

Disclaimer: This plugin is developed by Indedmedia and is not affiliated with, endorsed, or sponsored by Mautic.
“Mautic” is a registered trademark of its respective owners.

Upgrade to PRO

The PRO version includes advanced features:

  • Advanced WooCommerce: synchronization of existing contacts and automatic updates. Creation of custom fields in Mautic with order information.
  • Segments and campaigns: automatically assign leads to Mautic segments and campaigns to activate automation flows.
  • Advanced Elementor PRO: additional options in form integration, such as direct assignment to segments and campaigns, and mapping of custom fields.
  • Advanced UTM tracking: automatically records UTM parameters from visits and associates them with the contact in Mautic.
  • Priority premium support: technical assistance with reduced response times.
  • Exclusive updates: early access to new features and improvements not available in the free version.

Upgrade / Pro

The free plugin contains links to a commercial upgrade. The upgrade is sold and supported by Indedmedia.

External services

This plugin connects to your own Mautic instance through its REST API.
Data sent: email, first name, last name, order information (total, order ID, order status…), newsletter opt-in flag, and any custom fields you configure.
This service is provided by Mautic (open source project).
Mautic Privacy Policy: https://mautic.org/privacy-policy/

This plugin also includes links to Indedmedia.com for upgrade and documentation purposes.
Data sent: none automatically. Only if you click on the upgrade/documentation links, your browser will open the Indedmedia.com website.
Service provided by Indedmedia: https://www.indedmedia.com
Plugin Documentation: https://www.indedmedia.com/ayuda/plugins-para-wordpress/wp-integrations-for-mautic-pro/
Privacy Policy: https://www.indedmedia.com/politica-de-privacidad/
Terms of Service: https://www.indedmedia.com/aviso-legal/

Data sent to Mautic and Privacy

This plugin connects your WordPress site with your own Mautic instance.
Depending on the modules you enable, the following data may be sent to Mautic:

  • Elementor forms: name, email, and any additional fields you configure in the form.
  • WooCommerce: customer name, email, order details if you sync your fields with Mautic at woocommerce module setup (basic information such as order ID, order value, order number…), and the marketing consent status selected at checkout or in the customer account area.
  • Tracking code: page visits and UTM parameters if you enable Mautic tracking.

Data is sent only to the Mautic instance you configure in the plugin settings.
No data is transmitted to Indedmedia or to any third-party service other than your own Mautic.

Mautic privacy policy:
https://www.mautic.org/privacy-policy

➡️ More information and purchase at indedmedia.com.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org or upload it manually to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate it from the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to INTMAU Mautic > Connection Settings and enter your Mautic URL, Client ID, and Client Secret.
  4. Authorize the connection with your Mautic and activate the integrations you need from the “Modules” section.
  5. If you use WooCommerce, configure the integration under “Modules Setup”.
  6. In Elementor PRO, edit your form and go to Actions After Submit.
    Select Mautic as the action.
    Fill in the Tags field to assign a label.
    (Segments and campaigns are only available in the PRO version.)
sections.faq:
Do I need technical knowledge?

No, the plugin is designed to be plug & play. You only need your Mautic credentials.

Does it work with the cloud version of Mautic?

Yes, as long as you have API access enabled.

What is the difference between the free and PRO versions?

The PRO version includes advanced synchronization, premium support, and extra modules for WooCommerce and Elementor PRO.

Does the plugin send data to an external server?

Only to the Mautic instance whose URL you enter. No data is sent to us.

Where is my data stored?

Tokens and module settings are stored in your WordPress database (wp_options table).
